description: CMU C3D surface-marker mapping to 16 tracking landmarks.

source_axes.description: CMU C3D right-handed laboratory XYZ with +Z vertical.
evidence: 07_01.c3d POINT:X_SCREEN=+X, POINT:Y_SCREEN=+Z; screen orientation is supporting evidence, not a floor calibration.
07_01.c3d foot-marker Z is near 0 mm and head-marker Z is approximately 1515-1678 mm. Inspect the preview before accepting the convention.

world_from_source_m.ground_assumption: Use laboratory Z=0 with no additional translation. Surface-marker heights are not sole-contact measurements.
evidence: No independent floor calibration was supplied with 07_01.c3d. POINT:Y_SCREEN=+Z does not establish the floor origin.
Identity transform is deliberate so the preview exposes floor mismatch instead of concealing it with an automatic lift.

limitations: CMU files contain labeled reconstructed marker trajectories and may already be processed; do not call every sample raw camera data. CMU warns that other C3Ds can include synthetic BodyBuilder model outputs. This mapping uses only documented capture-marker labels.

CMU warns lower-numbered subjects are early sessions that may be lower quality. Its standard marker-placement guide/images are not a trial-specific calibration or proof of historical placement for subject 07.
Pelvis is a four-waist-marker centroid; head is a four-head-marker centroid. Neither is a measured center or a calibrated equivalent of the model's tracking site.

lhip/rhip are explicitly LFWT/RFWT anterior waist surface proxies. The capture marker set does not provide validated hip joint centers or model-equivalent lateral hip sites. No regression joint-center estimator is applied.

Knee/elbow/shoulder markers are external landmarks, not joint centers. The lhand/rhand targets are wrist-marker midpoints, not measured wrist joint centers. Toe/heel markers are surface markers, not sole contact points.
Some 07_01 left-toe surface-marker samples lie below Z=0; coordinates are retained.
No resampling, gap filling, trimming, smoothing, gait phase alignment, per-body scaling or force estimation is performed. Full native timing is retained.

pelvis.anatomical_meaning: Explicit centroid of the four anterior/posterior waist surface markers.
limitations: Derived geometric centroid; not pelvis COM, a joint center, or a calibrated equivalent of tracking[pelvis].

head.anatomical_meaning: Explicit centroid of all four front/back head-band surface markers.
limitations: Geometric marker centroid, not a measured anatomical head center; not calibrated to the model's anterior-head site.

ltoe.label: LTOE
ltoe.anatomical_meaning: Left forefoot surface marker on the bone just before the toe starts.
limitations: Not toe tip, MTP joint center, or sole contact point. Some 07_01 samples are below the proposed Z=0 plane.

rtoe.label: RTOE
rtoe.anatomical_meaning: Right forefoot surface marker on the bone just before the toe starts.
limitations: Not toe tip, MTP joint center, or sole contact point.

lheel.label: LHEE
limitations: Not sole contact point; marker radius, shoes and placement are not corrected.

rheel.label: RHEE
limitations: Not sole contact point; marker radius, shoes and placement are not corrected.

lknee.label: LKNE
lknee.anatomical_meaning: Left external knee-region marker, placed above the break between upper and lower leg per CMU guide.
limitations: Not knee joint center. Placement and soft tissue differ from the model's shin-body tracking site.

rknee.label: RKNE
rknee.anatomical_meaning: Right external knee-region marker, placed above the break between upper and lower leg per CMU guide.
limitations: Not knee joint center. Placement and soft tissue differ from the model's shin-body tracking site.

lhand.anatomical_meaning: Explicit midpoint of the left wrist A/B surface markers.
limitations: Wrist-marker midpoint, not a measured wrist joint center or calibrated equivalent of the model hand-body origin. Target name lhand is retained for runtime compatibility.

rhand.anatomical_meaning: Explicit midpoint of the right wrist A/B surface markers.
limitations: Wrist-marker midpoint, not a measured wrist joint center or calibrated equivalent of the model hand-body origin. Target name rhand is retained for runtime compatibility.

lelbow.label: LELB
lelbow.anatomical_meaning: Left external elbow-region surface marker per CMU placement guide.
limitations: Not elbow joint center; no joint-center substitution or offset is inferred.

relbow.label: RELB
relbow.anatomical_meaning: Right external elbow-region surface marker per CMU placement guide.
limitations: Not elbow joint center; no joint-center substitution or offset is inferred.

lshoulder.label: LSHO
lshoulder.anatomical_meaning: Left shoulder-bone surface marker per CMU guide.
limitations: Not glenohumeral joint center; not anatomically equivalent to the model upper-arm origin.

rshoulder.label: RSHO
rshoulder.anatomical_meaning: Right shoulder-bone surface marker per CMU guide.
limitations: Not glenohumeral joint center; not anatomically equivalent to the model upper-arm origin.

lhip.label: LFWT
lhip.anatomical_meaning: Left anterior waist/pelvis-bone surface marker used as the lhip landmark.
limitations: Surface proxy, not a hip joint center or greater-trochanter measurement.

rhip.label: RFWT
rhip.anatomical_meaning: Right anterior waist/pelvis-bone surface marker used as the rhip landmark.
limitations: Surface proxy, not a hip joint center or greater-trochanter measurement.
